title: Ladder
blurb: A painter, a can of paint and one long wooden ladder at the foot of a hundred-metre heap of junk. Lean it, climb it rung by rung, haul it up after you and lean it again. Enamel is slippery, steep ladders tip, hurried ones rock, and a bad lean can drop you most of the way down. At the end of the day, a replay of your worst fall.
